hook_text: Three clay models: a homestead, a village, a hilltop town. What changed in four hundred years?
clip_script: Musina, three clay models. Model one: a small farming homestead with a cattle kraal. Model two: a big village of hundreds of people, trading ivory for glass beads. Model three: a town with a king living on a hill above everyone else. Between about 900 and 1300 AD, societies in the Limpopo Valley grew bigger, more organised and more complex. More people, more trade, more wealth, more power for leaders. The road to Mapungubwe.
visual_style: Whiteboard table with three clay models drawing themselves left to right, a timeline arrow from 900 to 1300 underneath.
mood: Thoughtful and building, like watching something grow.
pacing: One model per beat, slow comparison, then a quick summary of the reasons.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list three ways your own town has grown bigger and more complex.
